settings.question: How long does it take to set up?
settings.answer: Most institutions are fully operational within 24 hours. Our guided setup wizard walks you through importing data, configuring settings, and inviting your team.

settings.question: Is there a free plan available?
settings.answer: Yes! Our Starter plan is completely free for institutions with up to 50 students. It includes core features like attendance, fee management, and basic reporting.

settings.question: Can I migrate from another platform?
settings.answer: Absolutely. We support imports from CSV, Excel, and most major education platforms. Our migration team is available to assist with complex data transfers at no additional cost.

settings.question: What kind of support do you offer?
settings.answer: All plans include email and chat support. Professional and Enterprise plans get priority support with guaranteed response times, plus access to a dedicated account manager.

settings.question: Is my data safe?
settings.answer: Security is our top priority. We use AES-256 encryption, daily backups, and our infrastructure is SOC 2 Type II certified. Your data is hosted on enterprise-grade servers with 99.99% uptime.
